summary: Immutep Limited filed a Form 6-K to disclose positive interim Phase I data for IMP761, a LAG-3 agonist antibody, to be presented at EULAR 2026. The filing reports clinical trial results, including safety, tolerability, and pharmacodynamic activity. No special situation such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is involved. As a routine reporting of clinical progress by a biotech company, this does not constitute a special event.
